# Central machine: peak memory during the payload sweep E4a (generated by scripts/docs/central_memory.py)

Source: `sysmon/central.json` of each E4a run directory on the central VM (`scripts/sysmon.py`, sampled every second; its "MB" is MiB). Peak RSS per process in MiB; from 32 MiB on, the factor in brackets is peak RSS / payload. *used* = peak memory in use on the whole machine (31.3 GiB RAM). Each table lists the processes of its scope plus the orchestrator and the hub core; long-lived processes of the other frameworks keep memory from their own earlier runs and are left out. Payload sizes are MiB per site and direction (`payload-<N>` echo model, 2 sites per framework).

The NVFlare relay job is one long-running process: in the mixed runs it still held about 2,000 MiB from the NVFlare-only sweep before them, so its mixed values are upper bounds and their factors say nothing about the payload.
